Joins tract EPA facility counts to CDC adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation with paired tract count.
sql:
WITH epa AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS epa_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_91c50a' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_91c50a_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
         COALESCE(e.epa_count, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(h.totalpopulation, 0) AS epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
         COALESCE(e.epa_count, 0) AS epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count,
         h.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation,
         h.totalpop18plus AS totalpop18plus,
         h.adult_asthma_prevalence,
         t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN epa e ON e.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE h.adult_asthma_prevalence IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT tract_name,
       epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count,
       totalpopulation,
       totalpop18plus,
       adult_asthma_prevalence,
       CORR(epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation, adult_asthma_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_echo_facilities_in_montgomery_county_al_count_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name
LIMIT 200
